algorithms.notes: Apply the upstream eigensolver to the explicitly constructed symmetric graph Laplacian. These are three numerical algorithms sharing the CuPy framework paper, not three graph-specific publications. Laplacian assembly and canonical output conversion are adapter requirements; verify residuals and nullspace multiplicity.
